report.summary: Chunk 2 of 5 of switches.py: defines _Binding, _ModuleInfo, helper functions for constant resolution, env read extraction, import binding analysis, and classification logic.
risks: _walk | low | Recursive generator may cause stack overflow on deeply nested ASTs; limited by Python recursion limit. | Add recursion depth check or iterative alternative.
_resolve_import_origin | medium | Assumes info_rel ends with filename; if not, parts slicing may be incorrect. | Verify that info_rel always ends with a filename.

_binding | medium | Uses lineno <= lineno for local bindings; if multiple bindings with same alias and same owner span, picks highest lineno, but may miss later bindings in same scope. | Clarify ordering of bindings.
_classify_kind | medium | Relies on _tokens function not shown; classification may be incomplete. | Review _tokens implementation.
_classify_kind | low | Heuristic for 'flag', 'number', etc. may misclassify unusual usage. | Add more patterns or user overrides.

handoff.purpose: Define internal data structures and helper functions for extracting and resolving environment variable switches from AST.

symbols.name: _Binding
symbols.note: Dataclass holding alias, origin, original, lineno, owner for an imported binding.

symbols.name: _ModuleInfo
symbols.note: Dataclass holding module relative path, AST, constants dict, and bindings list.

symbols.name: _module_constants
symbols.note: Extracts constant assignments from an AST module.

symbols.name: _walk
symbols.note: Generator yielding each node and its parents in an AST tree.

symbols.name: _enclosing
symbols.note: Returns the nearest ancestor of given types from parents list.

symbols.name: _qualname
symbols.note: Builds qualified name from ancestors and node.

symbols.name: _src
symbols.note: Returns unparsed source of an AST node, or 'None'/'?'.

symbols.name: _is_environ
symbols.note: Checks if node represents os.environ or bare environ.

symbols.name: _env_read
symbols.note: Detects environment variable read patterns (subscript, .get, getenv) and returns marker, default, via.

symbols.name: _name_expr
symbols.note: Extracts the expression representing the variable name from subscript or call.

symbols.name: _resolve_name
symbols.note: Resolves an expression to a string constant if possible.

symbols.name: _import_bindings
symbols.note: Extracts all `from X import NAME` bindings with scope and line numbers.

symbols.name: _resolve_import_origin
symbols.note: Resolves relative import to an absolute file path.

symbols.name: _Resolver
symbols.note: Resolves a constant Name to its value by following imports.

symbols.name: _resolve_default
symbols.note: Converts an expression to its constant string value, following imports.

symbols.name: _classify_kind
symbols.note: Classifies a switch into kind (platform, secret, number, flag, path, string) based on syntactic evidence.

symbols.name: _has_default_name
symbols.note: Checks if AST node contains a Name with 'DEFAULT' in its id.

symbols.name: _fallback_evidence
symbols.note: Signature only; body not in this chunk.

claims.text: `os.environ` or a bare `environ` imported from os.
claims.why: Code checks for ast.Attribute with .environ on Name 'os' or ast.Name with id 'environ'.

claims.text: Return (name_expr_source_marker, default_expr, via) for an env read.
claims.why: Function returns a tuple of three elements: str, Optional[ast.expr], str.

claims.text: `os.environ[k] = v` sets a variable, it is not a switch read, and counting it invents a required switch per write.
claims.why: Code returns None if node.ctx is not ast.Load, excluding writes.

claims.text: Every `from X import NAME` in a module, with its lexical scope.
claims.why: Function iterates all nodes, filters ast.ImportFrom, extracts bindings with alias, origin, original, lineno, owner.

claims.text: Defaults are routinely written as an imported constant, and this codebase imports two DIFFERENT constants under the SAME name `DEFAULT_MODEL` inside one function. Without the scope and the line number, reconciling defaults across modules would confidently compare the wrong values.
claims.why: Docstring describes a motivation, but the actual behavior of the code (extracting bindings with scope) is present; the claim about the specific example of DEFAULT_MODEL cannot be verified from this chunk.

claims.text: Resolves a constant Name to its value, following module imports.
claims.why: Class has value method that recursively resolves names via imports.

claims.text: The default's constant value as text, or None when it is not a literal.
claims.why: Returns None for non-literal expressions; for constants returns str(value), for Name uses resolver.

claims.text: Syntactic evidence first, then the enclosing signature, then the name.
claims.why: Code first checks name in _PLATFORM_ENV, then tokens, then walks parents for calls/comparisons/if, then checks return annotation, then token sets.

observations.what: _fallback_evidence is defined only by signature; body is in next chunk.
_walk uses recursion for AST traversal; could hit recursion limit on deeply nested trees.
_resolve_import_origin uses info_rel.split('/')[:-1] assuming info_rel ends with a filename; if not, slicing may be wrong.
_binding uses lineno <= lineno for local bindings; if multiple bindings with same alias and same owner span exist, selects highest lineno, but later bindings after lineno would be missed.
_classify_kind relies on _tokens function not shown in this chunk; classification may be incomplete.
